signal.rationale: Three purchase orders are firm (received, dated 22-23 September 2026) and carry a stated base value of INR 295.13-301.73 million, or 25.6-26.2% of TTM revenue of INR 115.35 crore (size STATED, lower end used). The company calls them ordinary course and the package is about one quarter of sales, so the orders are routine; with TTM OPM at 3.5%, the thin-margin exception applies and they are decided as non-routine. Annual revenue grew about 50% (FY2026 vs FY2025), so the exception reaches DEEP_RESEARCH; no disqualifier applies, but the failed rights issue leaves working-capital funding unresolved and confidence is LOW.
